experiment_data.hypothesis: Domain × model interaction: Pythia-1.4B on arXiv data 的 K* 是否与 exp-024 (Qwen on arXiv, K*=?) 一致？验证 arXiv domain effect 跨模型一致性，排除 Qwen-specific artifact。Pythia-1.4B continuation, nucleus p=0.95 T=1.0, 2200 docs, depth 0-5, scorer=Qwen2.5-1.5B base。

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && mkdir -p data/exp_025_pythia_arxiv && cp -n data/exp_024_arxiv/depth_0.jsonl data/exp_025_pythia_arxiv/depth_0.jsonl 2>/dev/null; PYTHIA_PATH=\$(find /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'pythia-1.4b*' | head -1) && if [ -z \"\$PYTHIA_PATH\" ]; then PYTHIA_PATH=\$(find /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache -maxdepth 3 -name 'config.json' -path '*pythia*' -exec dirname {} \\; | head -1); fi && echo \"[INFO] Using Pythia at: \$PYTHIA_PATH\" && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python scripts/run_pipeline.py --model_path \$PYTHIA_PATH --scorer_path /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2___5-1___5B --generation_mode continuation --top_p 0.95 --temperature 1.0 --num_samples 2200 --max_depth 5 --batch_size 8 --feat_batch_size 16 --data_dir data/exp_025_pythia_arxiv --results_dir results/exp_025_pythia_arxiv 2>&1 | tee logs/exp_025_pythia_arxiv.log"

metrics.key_finding: Pythia-1.4B on arXiv also K*=3, confirming domain effect (not Qwen-specific). 2v3=0.6545 robustly above θ=0.60.
